description: REGENERATED FROM THE AUTHORITATIVE M6 PHASE C WORK ORDER (not a verbatim recovery of the lost original). Local Banner handler/codec, installer/store reuse, restore, Banner-aware autostart, native renderer integration, and bounded WALL diagnostics. Adds a static Banner InstallationHandler (VALIDATE/PREPARE/ENCODE/COMMIT/READBACK/RESTORE/ARM) that reuses the EXISTING InstallationStore/InstallationSnapshot/InstallationSnapshotCodec/PackageInstaller path, performs the Banner cross-contract validation (bijection scenes/windows, offset-zero scenes, product=banner/clock=wall/pause=continue, no asset/image, animations none), restores a fresh temporal context, adds a Banner-known autostart decision without MediaSession grant, drives the native SceneRenderer for Banner through the common owner (FEAT-002) and WALL driver (FEAT-003), and extends RuntimeDiagnostics/DiagnosticsStore with the bounded WALL taxonomy. Covers Phase C scope items 8 (handler/codec), 10, 11, 12, 13 (local Banner handler), 14 (local diagnostics). Does NOT flip TvCapabilities to advertise WALL for production, does NOT touch Cloud (Phase D), and does NOT add a new store/installer/permission.
steps: Read docs/scenevibe-os-m6-banner-wall-clock-architecture.md sections 8 (handler in M4 pipeline), 9 (Banner without remote assets), 11 (ACK/durable), 12 (reboot/offline + BootReceiver residue), 15 (diagnostics), 16 (security) and VideoManifestInstallationHandler.java / VideoLegacyInstallationHandler.java / InstallationHandler.java / InstallationHandlerRegistry.java / PackageInstaller.java / InstallationStore.java / SceneRenderer.java / AutostartPolicy.java / BootReceiver.java first.

Add a static Banner InstallationHandler following the VideoManifestInstallationHandler pattern (stateless, bounded diagnostics, zero write/clock/timer in validate/prepare/encode/restore). It decodes the banner profile body (size-before-parse, closed form, unknown keys/types/versions rejected), parses product=banner / clock.mode=wall / pauseBehavior=continue, and performs the mandatory Banner cross-contract validation: scenes<->windows bijection, unique+safe IDs, equal counts, scene.id == eventId, every scene startMs == 0 (offset-zero), scene.durationMs == end-start exact long, domain/horizon valid, exact rendering contract, allowed primitives only, NO asset reference / NO image primitive / animations none (recursively), all M4 size bounds applied. Reuse the WallEvent/WallCalendar pure models for the window set. PREPARE binds typed immutable copies + id index + WALL/CONTINUE requirements; ENCODE/COMMIT snapshots the exact bytes + handlerId through the existing single atomic write; READBACK/RESTORE re-verifies the exact revision/codec/handler/artifact binding and reconstructs from the durable; ARM retires the old owner, loads durable calendar/manifest under pending, has the driver sample+prepare the wait, captures generation, and selects exactly one activation. ACK is authorizable ONLY on the ARMED result for the still-current revision and client.

Extend the capability/registry surface the minimal, finite way per section 8: reserve the Banner codec id (proposed scenevibe.banner-wall-overlay.v1) and make TvCapabilities recognize the Banner installation shape so InstallationHandlerRegistry can hold the two Video handlers PLUS one Banner handler with concordant counts/whitelist and a single expected artifact for the Banner codec. Keep the existing Video codec/contract/version values byte-unchanged and keep unknown codecs rejected. IMPORTANT: this is the registry/handler-shape extension needed for LOCAL qualification; it must not be presented as a live public capability flip, and supportsWallClockExecution() may become truthful ONLY for the assembled/qualified local path, never as a Cloud/public announcement (Cloud is Phase D). If a truthful local flip is made, it must be gated by the actual assembled path and covered by tests; if ambiguous, keep it false and document that local Banner qualification is proven by the composition tests rather than the flag.

Reuse the single durable path end-to-end: InstallationStore/InstallationSnapshot/InstallationSnapshotCodec + the corrected SharedPreferences transport (scenevibe.os.android-preference.v1: framing). Do NOT add a second store, installer, occurrence journal, or anchor/wallGeneration/ticket persistence. Restore creates a FRESH temporal context: restoreInstalledPackage reuses the same-revision installer path and ARMs via the common owner ports; a window active at boot can appear immediately after ARM under the new activation up to its absolute end; a fully-past window stays invisible (no replay/batch). Corruption of the durable fails closed (CACHE_FAILED) and never reaches the owner/controller/driver.

Drive the native SceneRenderer for Banner through the common owner + driver: Banner reuses the existing text/rectangle/table/group native paths, refuses image/asset, uses animations none and immediate removal on EXIT; a preflight/render refusal at DUE produces a bounded diagnostic and no partial display and does NOT loop retries each heartbeat. No second renderer, no deferred fade, no concurrent window. Video manifested keeps SceneRenderer; Video legacy keeps its qualified renderer/countdown (not deleted). The retirement of both native surfaces before any kind change is preserved.

Add the Banner-known autostart decision (section 12): extend AutostartPolicy with a bounded decision for a KNOWN Banner codec/handler snapshot that permits a boot-prepare (armed, not visible) start on opt-in + overlay + durable present WITHOUT a MediaSession/Notification grant, while Video / unknown / credentials-only / historical permission-ordering paths keep their existing decisions. Extend BootReceiver.decide to pass the durable kind (it still reads only metadata; no Banner parsing in the receiver; full validate/restore stays in the service). MainActivity must NOT acquire a MediaSession requirement to start Banner. No new permission, no Direct Boot.

Extend RuntimeDiagnostics with the bounded WALL taxonomy (section 15): NONE, WALL_CALENDAR_LOADED, WALL_ANCHORED, WALL_EVENT_DUE, WALL_EVENT_EXPIRED, WALL_EVENT_SUPERSEDED, WALL_CLOCK_REEVALUATED, WALL_CALENDAR_CLEARED, WALL_HORIZON_EXHAUSTED, WALL_DISPLAY_SUSPENDED, WALL_CLOCK_INVALID, WALL_DEADLINE_FAILED, and the corresponding observational-only DiagnosticsStore setters + DiagnosticsActivity view fields, following the existing enum/setter conventions. Admissible fields only: clock kind, revision, generation, bounded count, enum reason, anchor/timer state, bounded scalar drift/delay, saturating counters. NEVER unbounded ring log, Banner text, table content, user-supplied eventId, token, device credential, URL, payload, editorial source, or stack trace with data. Diagnostics never decide selection/clock/ACK.

Add JVM tests (JUnit4) following the existing M4PhaseD/E/F + CloudManifestCache + SceneRuntimeController test patterns and reusing Memory store/fixture doubles. Cover: Banner VALIDATE/PREPARE write-nothing; bijection/offset-zero/exact-duration/no-asset/no-image/animations-none accept and each violation rejects with a bounded WALL/manifest code; same-revision = zero repersist + ACK only of the durable binding; stale revision = zero mutation + no ARM/ACK; corrupt/readback/ARM-fail = no ACK with the prior revision intact (no mixed revision); ARM success + ACK-after-durable; restore returns a fresh temporal context and an active-at-boot window shows while a past window does not; registry holds exactly Video+Video+Banner with unknown codec rejected; AutostartPolicy Banner-known START without MediaSession and the existing Video/blocked decisions preserved; SceneRenderer Banner preflight refusal -> bounded diagnostic + no partial display + no retry loop; diagnostics carry only bounded enum/scalar fields. Keep app/.../wall/*.java and MediaCalendarScheduler byte-unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A static Banner InstallationHandler validates the full Banner cross-contract (bijection, offset-zero, exact durations, banner/wall/continue, no asset/image, animations none, M4 bounds) with zero side effects before commit, and ARMs via the common owner; ACK is authorizable only on ARMED for the current revision/client (ACK-after-durable, no mixed revision).

The existing single durable path (InstallationStore/Snapshot/Codec/PackageInstaller + corrected SharedPreferences transport) is reused with no second store/installer/journal and no durable anchor/generation/ticket; restore creates a fresh temporal context (active-at-boot window shows, past window stays invisible, corruption fails closed).

InstallationHandlerRegistry holds exactly the two Video handlers plus one Banner handler with unknown codecs still rejected; Video codec/contract/version values are byte-unchanged; any WALL capability truthfulness is gated by the assembled local path and covered by tests, never a Cloud/public flip.

Banner-known autostart permits an armed-not-visible boot start on opt-in+overlay+durable WITHOUT a MediaSession grant while all existing Video/unknown/credentials-only/permission-ordering decisions are preserved; BootReceiver reads only metadata and MainActivity needs no MediaSession for Banner; no new permission/Direct Boot.

RuntimeDiagnostics/DiagnosticsStore/DiagnosticsActivity gain the bounded WALL taxonomy (observational only, bounded enum/scalar fields, no content/token/credential/URL/payload); new JVM tests cover the handler/restore/registry/autostart/renderer/diagnostics matrix and pass (CI gate if no Android SDK); the pure wall/ package and MediaCalendarScheduler are byte-unchanged.
verification: cd tests && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p "test_*.py" (still 141 OK; pure WALL contract still 68/68)

git diff --stat confirms app/src/main/java/.../wall/*.java and calendar/MediaCalendarScheduler.java byte-unchanged; grep confirms Video codec/contract constants in TvCapabilities unchanged and no new permission in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

If an Android SDK can be provisioned under OPEN_INTERNET: Gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug :app:assembleDebug --console=plain (new handler/restore/autostart/renderer/diagnostics tests + all existing tests pass; APK builds). Otherwise declare the Android build/unit figures as CI-only gates honestly and rely on code review + the host Python/JDK gate.
